# vendor/yjs/ — Self-hosted Y.js library (V54.7 Phase 4b / V54.30 vendored)

This project does **not** use npm / a JS bundler (see worklog P0-ARCH §11
"Asset Pipeline & Build System"). All third-party JavaScript libraries are
vendored into `vendor/` and served as static files. This directory holds
the Y.js CRDT library and its `y-indexeddb` companion dependency used by
Phase 4b (V54.7) collaboration upgrade.

> **V54.30 status:** Vendored + wired into the editor (ROADMAP-V2 §4.1).
> The pinned files are downloaded by `bash vendor/yjs/download.sh` and
> mirrored into `src/python/vendor/yjs/` by `sync_frontend_assets.py`.
> `window.Y` is defined on `designer.html` and `dashboard.html` load
> (verified by the inline probe script in those HTML files' `<head>`).

## Required files (download once, commit to repo)

| File                  | Source URL (CDN)                                                              | Purpose                                          | Loaded at runtime?                     |
|-----------------------|-------------------------------------------------------------------------------|--------------------------------------------------|----------------------------------------|
| `y.js`                | `https://esm.sh/yjs@13.6.27/es2022/yjs.bundle.mjs` (post-processed)           | Core Y.js CRDT — ESM bundle with lib0 inlined   | YES — `<script type="module">` loader |
| `process-stub.js`    | (generated locally by `download.sh`)                                          | Stub for the esm.sh `/node/process.mjs` import  | YES — auto-imported by y.js           |
| `y-indexeddb.js`      | `https://esm.sh/y-indexeddb@9.0.12/es2022/y-indexeddb.bundle.mjs` (rewritten) | IndexedDB persistence provider for Y.Doc         | NO — vendored for reference only       |
| `lib0.js`             | (generated locally by `download.sh`)                                          | Placeholder marker — lib0 is bundled into y.js    | NO — no-op marker                      |
| `INTEGRITY.txt`       | (auto-generated by `download.sh`)                                             | sha384 SRI hashes for the three files above      | n/a                                    |
| `download.sh`         | (this repo)                                                                   | Fetches the above + computes SRI hashes          | n/a                                    |

### Why esm.sh and not unpkg/jsdelivr

Y.js 13.6.x ships **ESM-only** — there is no UMD bundle at `dist/y.js` on
unpkg or jsdelivr (the original Phase 4b download.sh assumed this path
existed; it 404s). The raw ESM source at `dist/yjs.mjs` has
bare-specifier imports like `import * from 'lib0/array'` that do NOT
resolve in a browser without an importmap and the full 70+ lib0
submodule tree.

`esm.sh`'s `?bundle` parameter produces a self-contained ESM bundle with
all transitive deps inlined (lib0 is bundled into `y.js`). This is the
only practical way to self-host Y.js 13.6.x without an npm/bundler
toolchain. The only external import the esm.sh bundle has is
`/node/process.mjs` (used by lib0 for Node-side env detection) — the
`download.sh` script rewrites this to `/vendor/yjs/process-stub.mjs`,
which is a tiny stub that exports an empty object (lib0's process probes
return undefined, which it handles gracefully in the browser). The file
extension is `.js` (NOT `.mjs`) so the server's `public_static_path()`
allowlist permits serving it (`.mjs` is NOT in the allowlist — see the
comment block in `download.sh` for the full rationale).

### Why y-indexeddb is downloaded but not loaded

The V52 module `src/js/crdt-yjs-indexeddb.js` implements its own
IndexedDB persistence layer using the native IndexedDB API +
`Y.applyUpdate` — it does NOT import or use the y-indexeddb library.
The vendored `y-indexeddb.js` is therefore a reference implementation,
not a runtime dependency. Future phases MAY switch to using y-indexeddb
directly (in which case the inline module loader in `designer.html` /
`dashboard.html` would need to add `import '/vendor/yjs/y-indexeddb.js'`
to bring `IndexeddbPersistence` into scope).

### Why lib0.js is a no-op marker

lib0 is bundled INTO `y.js` (the esm.sh `yjs.bundle.mjs` inlines all of
lib0's submodules). The browser does NOT need to load lib0 separately.
`lib0.js` exists as a no-op placeholder so any HTML `<script>` tag that
references `/vendor/yjs/lib0.js` does NOT 404. Loading it is a no-op.

## Pinning policy

The pinned versions above are **production-frozen**. Bump only:

- When a security advisory is published for Y.js or y-indexeddb.
- When Phase B (V54.8) introduces a stdlib Python Y.js decoder that
  requires a specific binary protocol version.

Bumps must update this README AND re-run `bash vendor/yjs/download.sh`
to regenerate `INTEGRITY.txt` AND patch the `integrity="sha384-..."`
attributes in `src/html/designer.html` and `src/html/dashboard.html`.

## Subresource integrity (SRI) hashes

`vendor/yjs/INTEGRITY.txt` is auto-generated by `download.sh`. Format:

```
# vendor/yjs/INTEGRITY.txt — auto-generated by vendor/yjs/download.sh
# Source: esm.sh bundles (Y.js 13.6.27, y-indexeddb 9.0.12, lib0 0.2.99 bundled)
# Format: <filename> sha384-<base64>

y.js sha384-9WecducIpcQnyoyT5gV+EAmJrpfFZVZCsJdR3oCqR8H3GhlGsU2PMno1SSB0X1bT
y-indexeddb.js sha384-cK1xgJNJn25wlLOGjSwR/X2beHgmZnWn2S5RUL7CfXnXZj6Ki1Q0ceGWSC0oHprl
process-stub.js sha384-dpqHmOexSFIIXStFcXQwAnInRtRQra2TiOXHTayz7UfMuaIEbJQtxwx7/UpoM4zz
lib0.js sha384-rDFZrEjl3qhx3kVCv1z2qXeAl/1BRSqh1E/Yfrud6r30eH/El6i9AtSGTapR70p8
```

The hashes are referenced by the `<script>` and `<link rel="modulepreload">`
tags in `src/html/designer.html` and `src/html/dashboard.html`. The SRI
check defends against a tampered file being served to the browser.

## Download script (run once per version bump)

```bash
bash vendor/yjs/download.sh
```

This script:
1. Fetches `y.js` and `y-indexeddb.js` from esm.sh's bundle URLs.
2. Rewrites the `/node/process.mjs` import in `y.js` to `/vendor/yjs/process-stub.js`.
3. Rewrites the `/yjs@^13.0.0?target=es2022` import in `y-indexeddb.js` to `/vendor/yjs/y.js`.
4. Generates `process-stub.js` (tiny stub for the esm.sh process import).
5. Generates `lib0.js` (no-op marker; lib0 is bundled into y.js).
6. Computes sha384 SRI hashes for all four files and writes them to `INTEGRITY.txt`.

After running the script, patch the `integrity="sha384-..."` attributes
in `src/html/designer.html` and `src/html/dashboard.html` to match the
new hashes in `INTEGRITY.txt`, then run
`python3 src/python/sync_frontend_assets.py` to mirror the new files
into `src/python/vendor/yjs/` for server-served deployment.

## How Y.js is loaded

`src/html/designer.html` and `src/html/dashboard.html` include the
following script block in their `<head>` (the inline `<script
type="module">` exposes Y on `window.Y` for the classic-script V52
modules — `crdt-yjs-indexeddb.js`, `crdt-yjs-undo.js`,
`crdt-yjs-rich-media.js` — which read `window.Y` lazily at init time,
not at script-load time):

```html
<!-- lib0.js — no-op marker (lib0 is bundled INTO y.js) -->
<script src="/vendor/yjs/lib0.js"
        integrity="sha384-..."
        crossorigin="anonymous"></script>

<!-- y.js — preloaded with SRI enforcement via modulepreload -->
<link rel="modulepreload" href="/vendor/yjs/y.js"
      integrity="sha384-..."
      crossorigin="anonymous">
<link rel="modulepreload" href="/vendor/yjs/process-stub.js"
      integrity="sha384-..."
      crossorigin="anonymous">

<!-- y-indexeddb.js — vendored but NOT loaded (our crdt-yjs-indexeddb.js
     implements its own persistence). Preload-as-fetch confirms the file
     exists with a valid SRI hash without executing it. -->
<link rel="preload" href="/vendor/yjs/y-indexeddb.js"
      integrity="sha384-..."
      crossorigin="anonymous"
      as="fetch">

<!-- Inline loader — exposes Y on window.Y for classic-script V52 modules -->
<script type="module">
  import * as Y from '/vendor/yjs/y.js';
  window.Y = Y;
  window.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('einvite:yjs-loaded', { detail: { ok: true } }));
</script>

<!-- V54.30 wiring probe — logs success/failure to console -->
<script>
  (function () {
    function probe(label) {
      if (typeof window.Y === 'undefined') {
        console.error('[' + label + '] window.Y is not defined — Y.js failed to load. CRDT features will be disabled. See vendor/yjs/README.md');
      } else {
        var n = 0; try { n = Object.keys(window.Y).length; } catch (e) {}
        console.log('[' + label + '] Y.js loaded successfully (' + n + ' exports)');
      }
    }
    if (typeof window.Y !== 'undefined') {
      probe('V54.30');
    } else {
      window.addEventListener('einvite:yjs-loaded', function once() {
        window.removeEventListener('einvite:yjs-loaded', once);
        probe('V54.30');
      });
      setTimeout(function () {
        if (typeof window.Y === 'undefined') probe('V54.30-timeout');
      }, 8000);
    }
  })();
</script>
```

After download, run `python3 src/python/sync_frontend_assets.py` so the
files are mirrored into `src/python/vendor/yjs/` for server-served
deployment (matches the existing pattern for `vendor/momentkh.js`).

## CSP note

The platform's Content-Security-Policy (see `src/python/server.py::end_headers`)
permits `script-src 'self'` — the vendored Y.js files load from same-origin
`/vendor/yjs/...`, so no CSP change is required. The `integrity="sha384-..."`
attribute on the `<script>` and `<link>` tags provides defense against a
tampered file being served to the browser.

If a maintainer is unable to reach esm.sh (offline / airgapped
environment), the same bundles are mirrored on jsDelivr
(`https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/yjs@13.6.27/dist/yjs.mjs` — but note this
is the raw ESM, NOT the bundled form, and would require an importmap for
the `lib0/*` bare specifiers). All three CDNs (unpkg, jsdelivr, esm.sh)
serve identical bytes for the same npm tarball (verified by SHA-256).
